rows.label: Cabinet approval
rows.value: 25 March 2026 (combined with Special Sitting 1 April 2026) — draft approved for public comment

rows.label: Gazette publication
rows.value: 10 April 2026 — Government Gazette No. 54477, Notice 3880 of 2026

rows.label: Public comment window
rows.value: 60 days from 10 April 2026 (closing 10 June 2026 at 16h00) — superseded by withdrawal

rows.label: Withdrawal
rows.value: ~26 April 2026 — Minister Solly Malatsi withdrew the draft after at least 6 of 67 academic citations were found to be AI-generated hallucinations. Called it 'an unacceptable lapse' that 'compromised the integrity and credibility of the draft policy'

rows.label: Revised timeline
rows.value: No immediate timeline for a revised draft. Reports suggest 2027. Minister committed to resubmitting with 'much more rigorous oversight'

rows.label: Regulatory model
rows.value: Sector-specific, multi-regulator (financial services, health, education, telecoms) — as described in withdrawn draft

rows.label: Background
rows.value: October 2024 DCDT Policy Framework published as the precursor document
